label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I ii q.94…: The precepts of the natural law are to practical…
locator: I-II q.94 a.2 co.: praecepta legis naturae hoc modo se habent ad rationem practicam, sicut principia prima demonstrationum se habent ad rationem speculativam: utraque enim sunt quaedam principia per se nota
interpretation: Aquinas places the precepts of the natural law beside the first principles of demonstration: both are per se nota. As being is first in apprehension simply and grounds the first indemonstrable principle (non-contradiction, Metaphysics IV), so the good is first in the apprehension of practical reason and grounds the first practical principle. Read as the self-evidence claim for the first precept; it is the justification proposed in candidate AQUINAS-FIRST-PRECEPT-SELF-EVIDENT, not yet a self_evident marking.
